paths.title: Malec-Keth Janissary
paths.description: Stand ready to trade places with a threatened companion, turning a sudden rescue into an opening for both your blades. Your magic lets you appear at an ally's side to reinforce their defenses, while your elemental training eventually adds a chosen energy to every attack. When the fighting grows fierce, a wider assault or shielding aegis and resistance-breaking attacks help you keep control, culminating in an elemental eruption that lets your allies teleport clear.

paths.title: Sigil Carver
paths.description: Make your side of the battlefield a refuge, tracing wards that strengthen the defenses of companions standing beside you. An enemy that strikes one of those companions despite your mark can eventually feel your blade from well beyond its normal reach, making your shelter dangerous to challenge. Extra shielding marks, timely rescue teleports, and a sigil that lends force to your allies' melee attacks let you protect the group without surrendering the initiative.

paths.title: Sword of Assault
paths.description: Answer an enemy's defiance with a spell-laden blade, replacing your assault aegis's ordinary retaliation with a Swordmage at-will attack. An action point charge can carry an even stronger technique into the enemy line, and later a successful melee blow can open the way for a quick additional spell. With another aegis mark to spread your attention and attacks charged with elemental force, you press your advantage through sudden, concentrated violence.

paths.title: Wandering Swordmage
paths.description: Read the battlefield with a traveler's eye, letting Wisdom widen the reach of your assault or shielding aegis and guide a sharp answer to enemies that wound you deeply. Teleport before an action point maneuver, or catch a marked attacker in a magical snare that carries both of you away from your threatened ally. Your adaptable swordplay tests whichever defense looks weakest, while a circling guard of spectral blades can shelter companions and steadily cut at nearby foes.

paths.title: Ghost Blade
paths.description: Slip between solid form and ghostly presence, emerging from a teleport with an opening for your next weapon strike. Spending an action point makes you insubstantial, and your defensive magic can also let you pass through obstacles, with later benefits extending your teleports and exposing marked enemies while you remain elusive. Your blade can cut through an insubstantial foe's protection, and your greatest assault carries you from enemy to enemy before returning you to where you began.

paths.title: Coronal Guard
paths.description: Meet danger with a patient guard, turning your shielding aegis into a reserve of temporary health while strengthening your own magical defenses. When an enemy reaches for an ally, a thunderous counterstroke can drive it out of reach before its blow lands. Defensive surges and a lasting ward help you endure the pressure, while a powerful finishing strike sends a troublesome foe elsewhere on the battlefield.

paths.title: Arcane Hunter
paths.description: Look past a creature's imposing hide or ghostly form and find the weakness your blade can exploit. Your action point attack pierces resistance and insubstantial protection, while critical hits and carefully placed strikes punish existing vulnerabilities and later attacks wear through resistance more easily. An elemental stance lets you create vulnerabilities of your own, setting up attacks from you and your companions to bite deeper into the same wounded prey.
